title: My birthday party
instructions: Nora doğum günü partisini anlatıyor. Tarih, yer ve hediyelere dikkat et.

script.speaker: nora
script.text: My birthday is on the fifth of May.

script.speaker: nora
script.text: This year, I am ten years old.

script.speaker: nora
script.text: My party is at home, in the garden.

script.speaker: nora
script.text: Twelve friends from my class are coming.

script.speaker: nora
script.text: My mum is making a big chocolate cake.

script.speaker: nora
script.text: We are going to play games and dance.

script.speaker: nora
script.text: I want a new bike for my birthday. My old bike is too small!

questions.feedback: Doğum günü beş mayıs (the fifth of May). On, yaşı; on iki, arkadaş sayısı.
questions.evidence: My birthday is on the fifth of May.

questions.feedback: Parti evde, bahçede (at home, in the garden).
questions.evidence: My party is at home, in the garden.

questions.prompt: What does Nora want for her birthday?
questions.feedback: Yeni bir bisiklet (a new bike) istiyor; eskisi çok küçük.
questions.evidence: I want a new bike for my birthday.
